dialogue.origin: クライアント役です入りました
dialogue.content: I'm playing the client. I've joined the room.

dialogue.origin: 相談のテーマは希望ありますか？
dialogue.content: Do you have any preference for the counseling topic?

dialogue.origin: こんばんは
dialogue.content: Good evening.

dialogue.origin: こんばんは
dialogue.content: Good evening.

dialogue.origin: 特にはありませんよ
dialogue.content: Not in particular.

dialogue.origin: わかりました
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: ２０時になりましたらスタートして大丈夫ですか？
dialogue.content: Is it all right if we begin at 8:00 PM?

dialogue.origin: はいお願いします
dialogue.content: Yes, please.

dialogue.origin: こちらこそよろしくお願いします
dialogue.content: Likewise, I'm looking forward to our session.

dialogue.origin: こんばんは。それでは始めますね。今日はどのようなご相談でしょうか？
dialogue.content: Good evening. Let’s get started. What would you like to discuss today?

dialogue.origin: こんばんは。
dialogue.content: Good evening.

dialogue.origin: 息子のことで悩んでます
dialogue.content: I'm worried about my son.

dialogue.origin: 息子さんのことでお悩みなのですね？お話聞かせてもらえますか？
dialogue.content: So you're worried about your son? Would you mind telling me more about it?

dialogue.origin: はい息子のことが心配で
dialogue.content: Yes, I'm just so worried about him.

dialogue.origin: 中学生になって性教育とか、親としてはしないといけないと感じるのですが
dialogue.content: He's in middle school now, and as a parent, I feel I need to address sex education with him.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: 最近、夫の影響で大丈夫なのかなと…
dialogue.content: But lately, with my husband's influence, I'm wondering if he'll be okay...

dialogue.origin: 私が夫と話さないのがいけないんですけど
dialogue.content: Although, I know I'm at fault for not talking with my husband.

dialogue.origin: そうなのですね。何か心配に思われる事があったのですね
dialogue.content: I understand. Something must have happened to make you feel concerned.

dialogue.origin: 漠然と…夫の本棚には妄想だらけのエロい漫画とか沢山あるのを息子も読んでいるみたいで
dialogue.content: It's a vague feeling... My husband has a lot of erotic manga full of fantasies on his bookshelf, and it seems my son has been reading them.

dialogue.origin: 息子さんの様子きかせてもらえますか？
dialogue.content: Could you tell me about your son's behavior?

dialogue.origin: そうなのですね・・お母さんとしては
dialogue.content: I see... As his mother, that must be concerning.

dialogue.origin: 男の子も、正しい知識がないと危ない気がします
dialogue.content: I feel that boys can also be in danger if they don't have the proper knowledge.

dialogue.origin: ごもっともです
dialogue.content: You’re absolutely right.

dialogue.origin: どうしたらいいんでしょうか？
dialogue.content: What should I do?

dialogue.origin: そういうのを放置する夫にも呆れてしまいます
dialogue.content: I'm also exasperated with my husband for just letting it happen.

dialogue.origin: そうですか・・ご主人様とも話ができていないのですね
dialogue.content: I see... So you haven't been able to speak with your husband, either.

dialogue.origin: そうですね全く会話がありません
dialogue.content: That's right. We don't talk at all.

dialogue.origin: 男同士の方がそうゆう話は、とおもいますよね
dialogue.content: You would think those kinds of conversations are better had between men, wouldn't you?

dialogue.origin: そうなんです。でももう挨拶もしないし家の会話は全て子供を通して伝えてもらうくらいなので
dialogue.content: Exactly. But we don’t even greet each other anymore, to the point that all our communication at home goes through our child.

dialogue.origin: 夫とは話す気になれないのももう、長いんです
dialogue.content: It's been a long time since I've felt any desire to talk to my husband.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね・・それは、お辛い状況ですね。ご主人様は放置ということですが、どのようなお考えの方だとおもわれますか？
dialogue.content: I see... that sounds like a very difficult situation. You mentioned your husband is letting it happen; what do you think his perspective is?

dialogue.origin: 夫は、、、自分が好きで楽しいものは息子にも楽しませたいと思ってます
dialogue.content: My husband... he thinks that if he likes something and finds it fun, he wants our son to enjoy it too.

dialogue.origin: でも、その内容に私は納得がいきません
dialogue.content: But I just can't approve of the content.

dialogue.origin: 漫画とか小さい頃には仮面ライダーの音の出るベルトとか。。。
dialogue.content: Manga, and when he was little, things like a Kamen Rider belt that makes sounds…

dialogue.origin: そうですね。内容にもよりますよね
dialogue.content: I agree. It really depends on the content.

dialogue.origin: 好きなものを与えておられたのですね
dialogue.content: So he was giving him things that he himself liked.

dialogue.origin: 私がそういゆものを嫌いだと分かっているのに買い与えていて頭にきます
dialogue.content: It infuriates me that he buys him those things, knowing full well that I dislike them.

dialogue.origin: 息子のことは考えてないんです。自分が好きなものを与えるので
dialogue.content: He's not thinking about our son. He just gives him things that he likes.

dialogue.origin: 嫌いだと話されていた時もあるのですね？
dialogue.content: So you have told him before that you dislike them?

dialogue.origin: そうですね、それがわかっていて結婚したと思ってましたけど
dialogue.content: Yes, I thought he understood that when we got married.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: その、ベルトが、きっかけなんです
dialogue.content: That belt was the trigger.

dialogue.origin: ベルトが？？
dialogue.content: The belt??

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね？
dialogue.content: Is that so?

dialogue.origin: 私が下の子のお産が大変で2ヶ月入院して帰ってきたら、実家のおばあちゃんが買ってくれたとか言って
dialogue.content: I had a difficult delivery with our younger child and was hospitalized for two months. When I came home, he claimed my mother had bought it.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 私がなんで？？って聞いたらうるさいってソッポを向かれました。
dialogue.content: When I asked why, he just said, "You're being annoying," and turned away from me.

dialogue.origin: 自分が好きなものは息子も好きにきまってるとお思いのご主人なのですね？
dialogue.content: So your husband is the type who just assumes that if he likes something, his son is bound to like it too?

dialogue.origin: こちらの体調もよくないのに自分もお前の入院で大変だったとか言って、、、
dialogue.content: Even though I wasn't feeling well, he said things like he had a hard time too because I was in the hospital...

dialogue.origin: 息子も、喜んではいるんだと思います。
dialogue.content: I think our son was happy about it, though.

dialogue.origin: うるさいと言われたら言葉がでなくなりますよね
dialogue.content: Being told "you're annoying" can really leave you speechless, can't it?

dialogue.origin: はいひどいと思いました
dialogue.content: Yes, I thought it was awful.

dialogue.origin: お産で大変な時にと思いますよね
dialogue.content: Especially during such a difficult time after giving birth.

dialogue.origin: はい。喜ぶものを何でも与えるのは私は違うと思うんです
dialogue.content: Yes. I don't think it's right to just give a child anything that makes them happy.

dialogue.origin: そのようにはなされた事はありますか
dialogue.content: Have you ever told him that?

dialogue.origin: それまでは私がいろんなものにこだわりがあることを、理解してくれていると思ってました
dialogue.content: Before that happened, I thought he understood that I have strong feelings about various things.

dialogue.origin: ええ
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: 勝手でいつも自分中心なんです
dialogue.content: He’s selfish and always self-centered.

dialogue.origin: お子さんが出来る前は違ったのでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Was he different before you had children?

dialogue.origin: 自分勝手と思ってしまいますよね
dialogue.content: It's understandable that you'd think he's selfish.

dialogue.origin: わかりません仮面ライダーを好きとは聞いたことがなかったかもしれないです
dialogue.content: I don't know. I don't think I'd ever heard him say he liked Kamen Rider before.

dialogue.origin: お互いのことは好きならそれはそれ、なんでしょうけど子供にどうするかは
dialogue.content: If we like each other, that's one thing, but how to handle things with our child is another matter.

dialogue.origin: 相談する機会がそれ以来ない気がします
dialogue.content: I feel like we haven't had a chance to discuss things since then.

dialogue.origin: そうですよね！
dialogue.content: I completely understand.

dialogue.origin: 機会があれば相談したいとは思われますか？
dialogue.content: If you had the opportunity, would you want to talk with him?

dialogue.origin: 色々ありすぎて夫に話しかけたいという気持ちは無いです
dialogue.content: Too much has happened. I have no desire to speak to my husband.

dialogue.origin: 色々あると、そうゆう気持ちになってしまいますね
dialogue.content: When so much has happened, it's natural to feel that way.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: お子さんが出来る前は相談されたりできていたのですか？
dialogue.content: Before you had children, were you able to discuss things with each other?

dialogue.origin: 何をですか？
dialogue.content: About what?

dialogue.origin: 夫婦であなたの気持ちを伝えたり
dialogue.content: As a couple, sharing your feelings with each other.

dialogue.origin: そんなにできてなかったかもしれませんね、、、
dialogue.content: We probably didn't do that very much...

dialogue.origin: それで、性教育の話なんですけど
dialogue.content: Anyway, about the sex education issue...

dialogue.origin: はい、
dialogue.content: Yes,

dialogue.origin: 夫婦仲が悪いのにあなた達は愛の結晶なんだよって、言えないのが辛いんです
dialogue.content: It's painful that I can't tell them they were born out of love when my husband and I are on such bad terms.

dialogue.origin: でも別に、その退院した時の会話が発端で決裂してしまったので
dialogue.content: But then again, our relationship only fell apart after that conversation when I came home from the hospital.

dialogue.origin: 嘘ではないとは思うのですが
dialogue.content: So I don't think it would be a lie.

dialogue.origin: 子供にも、どうして話さないの？って言われるくらいなので…
dialogue.content: It's gotten to the point where even our children ask me, "Why don't you two talk?"

dialogue.origin: とても色々あったのですね。決裂されたとは・・
dialogue.content: It sounds like a great deal has happened, for things to break down like that...

dialogue.origin: つまり・
dialogue.content: So...

dialogue.origin: たぶん、産後うつだったんだと思うんですよね、私。
dialogue.content: I think I probably had postpartum depression.

dialogue.origin: 気持ちがご主人に向いていない？という事ですか？出産うつはお辛かったですね
dialogue.content: Do you mean your feelings are no longer directed towards your husband? Postpartum depression must have been very difficult.

dialogue.origin: 今はもう、夫に気持ちは無いですね
dialogue.content: Right now, I no longer have any feelings for my husband.

dialogue.origin: そうですか。ご主人に今一番何を理解してもらいたいですか？
dialogue.content: I see. What would you most like your husband to understand right now?

dialogue.origin: そうですね私の辛い気持ちをわかって欲しかったです
dialogue.content: Well... I wanted him to understand how much I was struggling.

dialogue.origin: そうですよね・・
dialogue.content: I understand…

dialogue.origin: あ、でもそれは諦めたというか。。。
dialogue.content: Oh, but I've sort of given up on that...

dialogue.origin: 出産ってほんと大変！！
dialogue.content: Childbirth is so incredibly hard!

dialogue.origin: もう理解してもらっても・・というお気持ちなのですか？
dialogue.content: So you feel that even if he understood now, it wouldn't make a difference?

dialogue.origin: 今は子供のことの方が心配で。。
dialogue.content: Right now, I'm more worried about my children.

dialogue.origin: そうですか！怒りや悲しみを通り越して、お子さんの事のみになってしまったのですね
dialogue.content: I see. You've moved past the anger and sadness, and now your children are your sole focus.

dialogue.origin: 相談もしたくない程になってしまられたのですね
dialogue.content: It's gotten to the point where you don't even want to talk to him.

dialogue.origin: はい。これ以上傷つくのが怖いのかもしれません。出産した後、もっと優しくしてもらえたら違ったかもしれませんね・・
dialogue.content: Yes. Maybe I'm scared of getting hurt anymore. Things might have been different if he had been kinder to me after I gave birth...

dialogue.origin: そうですよね！！！
dialogue.content: I completely agree!

dialogue.origin: 最近も、子供のお迎えの途中でちょっとした接触事故があって
dialogue.content: Recently, I was in a minor fender bender while picking up our child.

dialogue.origin: ええ
dialogue.content: Uh-huh.

dialogue.origin: そのことも、もう怒られるのがわかっていたので先に自分でいろいろと処理をしたんですけど
dialogue.content: I knew he would just get angry about it, so I handled everything myself beforehand.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですか！
dialogue.content: You did?

dialogue.origin: ご自分で！
dialogue.content: By yourself!

dialogue.origin: 子どもから夫の耳に入ったらしくて第一声がなんで言わないんだ⁈って怒るんです
dialogue.content: Apparently my husband heard about it from our child, and the first thing he did was yell, "Why didn't you tell me?!"

dialogue.origin: 怒られたのですか？
dialogue.content: He got angry at you?

dialogue.origin: 事故って、私の心配はしてくれない
dialogue.content: I was in an accident, and he wasn't even concerned about me.

dialogue.origin: それは、悲しくなりますね
dialogue.content: That must have been very saddening.

dialogue.origin: はい！私なりに精一杯やっているのに
dialogue.content: Yes! Even though I'm doing the best I can.

dialogue.origin: いつも上から目線で
dialogue.content: He's always so condescending.

dialogue.origin: はい。精一杯お子さんを出産され大仕事ですよね
dialogue.content: Yes. Giving birth with all your might is a huge accomplishment.

dialogue.origin: そうですよね
dialogue.content: It is, isn't it?

dialogue.origin: 対等ではなく上から目線なのですね。
dialogue.content: So he doesn't see you as an equal, but looks down on you.

dialogue.origin: いつも、そうなので息子が影響されてきている感じがします
dialogue.content: It's always like that, and I feel like it's starting to influence our son.

dialogue.origin: でもお子さんに与えるの物は甘いのですね・・
dialogue.content: And yet he's so indulgent when it comes to giving things to your son...

dialogue.origin: はいしかめ面してるよりおもしろがってていいよなあ？って
dialogue.content: Yes, his attitude is like, "It's better to have fun than to scowl all the time, right?"

dialogue.origin: お母さんの思いとは別に、息子さんに悪影響は性教育以外にも何かありますか
dialogue.content: Aside from how it makes you feel, are there any other negative influences on your son besides the sex education issue?

dialogue.origin: ええ、私がため息をつくのを夫は軽蔑するのですが、息子も私を同じ目線で見ているかなと思うことがあります
dialogue.content: Yes. My husband is contemptuous when I sigh, and sometimes I think my son is starting to look at me the same way.

dialogue.origin: ため息つくのは心を落ち着かせるためなんだよって子供には言って聞かせてますけど
dialogue.content: I've explained to my son that I sigh to calm myself down, though.

dialogue.origin: それは・・辛いですね。ちなみに息子さんにお母さんの気持ち伝わっているのでしょうか。一生懸命心配している事とか
dialogue.content: That must be... very painful. By the way, do you think your son understands how you feel? That you're so worried about him?

dialogue.origin: うーん日常的に話はしているので
dialogue.content: Hmm, well, we do talk every day.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: でも、中学生になって多感な年頃で父寄りになっている気がします
dialogue.content: But now that he's in middle school, it's a sensitive age, and I feel like he's starting to side with his father.

dialogue.origin: ご主人のように上から目線にならないかと心配ですよね
dialogue.content: You're worried he might become condescending like your husband.

dialogue.origin: そうなんです人として嫌なところが似ないといいなと思うのですが
dialogue.content: Exactly. As a person, I hope he doesn't pick up those unpleasant traits.

dialogue.origin: 是非お母さんとお子さんと沢山お話して欲しいと思いました。お母さんは周りをよくみていらしゃるので
dialogue.content: I really hope you can talk a lot with your son. You seem to be very aware of what's going on around you.

dialogue.origin: 難しいです
dialogue.content: It’s difficult.

dialogue.origin: お話、難しいですか・・
dialogue.content: Is it hard to talk…

dialogue.origin: でも、やってみます
dialogue.content: But I’ll give it a try.

dialogue.origin: 是非、出産の大変だったお話なふどを・・
dialogue.content: Please, maybe you could tell him stories, like about how difficult childbirth was...

dialogue.origin: 失礼しました。お話など
dialogue.content: Excuse me. Stories and things like that.

dialogue.origin: ええ！そうですね。。。
dialogue.content: Oh! Yes, that's a good idea...

dialogue.origin: 時間になってしまいましたね
dialogue.content: It looks like our time is up.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: タイピング遅くてすみませんでした
dialogue.content: I'm sorry my typing was slow.

dialogue.origin: いえ、たくさん話したいことがあったものですみません
dialogue.content: No, I’m sorry—I had so much I wanted to talk about.

dialogue.origin: もっと沢山聞きたかったです。
dialogue.content: I wish we had more time to talk.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます
dialogue.content: Thank you.

dialogue.origin: 終了ボタンをおしますね
dialogue.content: I’ll press the end button now.

dialogue.origin: はい。ありがとうございました！
dialogue.content: Yes. Thank you very much!

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございました
dialogue.content: Thank you.

topic.sub: 子供に対する教育方針の不一致
